must_hit.says: Blink Dagger came at 29:31, after Mage Slayer (16:06) and Consecrated Wraps (21:24). Ursa had Blink at 17:21, and 81% of professional Tidehunters (73 games, 7.41f) have it by 24:59.
Ursa took 8 of the 12 deaths, and 65% of the damage in the death windows was Ursa's attacks, while the first two big items answered magic damage.

Of the three deaths before 10:00, 4:21 came while last-hitting at 47% health with Ursa and Hoodwink on him, and at 6:07 he walked away from his fountain at 20% health into Ursa. A finding on them says what he was doing (last-hitting, walking out), not only that his health was low (owner, 2026-11-27: "血量见底还留在线上继续换血" alone means nothing).

Owner, 2026-11-27: against Ursa the item answer is one that stops him attacking or takes the player out of his reach (Eul's Scepter, Heaven's Halberd's disarm, Ghost Scepter, Force Staff), not stacking armor. Valve's data: Fury Swipes adds damage on consecutive attacks on the same target and is lost after 8 s without one; Enrage cannot be dispelled. Pros on Tidehunter against Ursa built Eul's in 36.7% of 98 games (8.3% usually; build_check answers_to_top_killers).

lead_why: The two are one lesson from two sides: 5700 gold on magic resistance and a Blink at 29:31, while Ursa's attacks took 8 of the 12 deaths. Two lane deaths below half health are a point to make, not the first one in a 45-minute game.

must_not.says: Owner, 2026-11-27: findings titled by a shared condition ("孤身留在原地，死了也没换回东西", "血量见底还留在线上继续换血") say nothing the player can act on. A finding names the decision: what he was doing and what to do instead.
must_not.pattern: 孤身留在原地|死了也没换回东西|血量见底还留在线上|[Ss]tay(?:ed|ing)? alone[^.]{0,30}(?:bought|traded) nothing

must_not.says: At 32:34 he was heading home (3477 closer to his fountain over the window, Blink used 7.6 s before) and Ursa caught him: a review must not say he stayed in the lane trading.
Owner, 2026-11-27, on a review that said "把这笔钱花在希瓦的守护上…替掉 21:24 的圣化护服": Shiva's Guard (armor) is not the answer to Ursa; advice must not tell him to buy it.

Owner, 2026-11-28 ("熊战士是普攻累积性伤害，堆护甲没用"): Ursa's damage is attacks stacking Fury Swipes under Overpower and Enrage, so an item that only reduces each hit (armor or damage block: Crimson Guard, Blade Mail, Assault Cuirass, Solar Crest, Shiva's Guard) is not the answer; the answer stops him attacking or dispels his buff (Heaven's Halberd, Eul's on him, Ghost Scepter). Advice that tells him to buy, prioritise or stack those, even beside a right item, breaks this.
